description: Golden fixture for the scorecard parity section (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/3301, slice S12). rows.jsonl is every parity cell one real validate run measured, compared again from that run's retained logs by this change's test-harness (see recompare) and wrapped as parity-ledger/v1 rows exactly as test-harness parity export plus the dev-hermit writer would publish them. committed-cells.json is the parity selection of the run's own Hermit commit. expected-parity.json is scorecard.rs's summary of those rows (the bytes it would write to scorecard/parity.json); the parity_summary_tests fixture test compares the two and names a temporary file holding the actual summary when they differ. map_s17.py and fixture_wrap.py are the two scripts that produced rows.jsonl (see id_mapping and wrap_script); the fixture test reads neither of them, nor this file.

wrapper.note: The sha256 covers the literal file, whose second line names dev-hermit's bin/safehermit by its absolute path under the measuring account's home directory; the text above spells that directory $HOME because scripts/check-portable-paths.sh refuses a home path in a tracked ci/ file. With $HOME expanded the text is the file byte for byte. The wrapper runs every hermit invocation through bin/safehermit, the real binary given as a positional path, with HERMIT_BIN unset so that safehermit cannot resolve back to the wrapper. Before any compare it was run once with log-diff --help (exit 0): process snapshots showed no safehermit started with anything but the real binary.

recompare.why: The run's own post-pass records predate this change's typed unavailable_class and operand, and they name retired backend-parity-c test ids, which this change's test-harness parity compare refuses to select: parse_parity_cell (ci/manifest-plan/src/parity.rs:1301) rejects a cell whose test no manifest declares (parity.rs:1310, "retired or misspelled"). So the run's retained inputs were copied, their ids mapped to the successors (id_mapping), and every cell the run's post-pass measured was compared again. A compare reads the logs the run retained; no guest ran.
recompare.inputs: A copy of the run's retained e2e/runs directory and both e2e/<lane>/manifest_backend_parity_c node directories (dev-hermit ignored/validate/artifacts/<run_id>/, see source_root): 6867 files, 132928503 bytes, each listed with its sha256 in a manifest (sha256 1fa4272fc998d6b1153c3a3e80a05660053eaddbf3d5ee02f850492f5f4490c3) that was verified after the copy. The originals were only read.
recompare.command: env -C <copy root> HERMIT_BIN=<wrapper> test-harness parity compare --artifacts <copy root>/e2e/<lane>/manifest_backend_parity_c --cell <cell> ... --jobs 8, under nice -n 10 and /usr/bin/time -v, once per lane, with one --cell for each cell the run's own post-pass measured in that lane, mapped as in id_mapping. It writes <artifacts>/parity-compare/parity.jsonl and parity.status.json. A one-cell trial (c-programs/aio-refusal@kvm, --jobs 1) ran first; its output directory was renamed aside before the full compare, which refused to start over an existing one.
